notes: Bandar publishes price-free menus on its own site — bandarrestaurant.com/menu/dinner-2/ is a set of images literally named '3-Dining-Menu-NO-PRICE', and the Special Menu image is a 3-course prix fixe with no price either. The only priced menu the restaurant itself points at is Uber Eats, which is the target of the 'Online Order' link on bandarrestaurant.com/contact/, so prices here come from there. Confidence is medium because a delivery platform's prices can carry a markup: a Yelp-sourced figure of about $35 for Chicken Soltani circulates against Uber Eats' $42 (~1.20x), but that Yelp listing is a stale duplicate page and Yelp's current menu for this business carries no prices at all, so the discrepancy could not be resolved. The prices do not divide cleanly by 1.15 or 1.30, so there is no uniform markup signature. Address confirmed as 845 4th Ave, San Diego, CA 92101 (Gaslamp) on the restaurant's own site. Bandar's printed menu states a 4% surcharge is added to all guest checks, and an automatic 20% gratuity for parties of 6 or more; the prices below are pre-surcharge. Dish descriptions were cleaned against the restaurant's own menu text on OpenTable, because Uber Eats has the descriptions for the three vegetarian stews shuffled.

A uniform delivery markup would not produce a negative delta or reconcile combos exactly, so these read as a newer pricing generation rather than a platform markup — but I could not confirm them against a first-party 2026 source, hence medium confidence. Expect in-store Classics to run roughly $2-4 lower than listed if the printed menu has not been reprinted.
